name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Specialist | Complex SaaS Configuration, Concurrent Implementations, Change Management | Integrations
summary: Implementation specialist with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, running concurrent implementations of configurable platforms from scoping through configuration, integration, training, and go-live. At Accelo I scoped and sequenced implementations of a CRM, project, and billing platform for professional-services firms, advising executives on how to run their operations through it. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with ~25 in flight at once, at 110% of implementation targets, and led teams of up to 30. Builds and debugs integrations hands-on (REST APIs, webhooks, JSON), coaches customers through process change, and turns recurring issues into repeatable process.

experience.title: Implementation Lead (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Lead end-to-end implementations of multi-workflow CRM and automation systems, translating business requirements from discovery into tailored configuration, then training owners and staff on the new process.
Configure multi-step workflows across lead routing, qualification, booking, onboarding, and reactivation, with 20+ automations in production for a single system.
Build and debug integrations with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth and API-key credentials, and JSON payloads in Zapier, Make, n8n, and GoHighLevel.
Validate every configuration and data import before launch, and document each decision and deliverable so the setup stays auditable after go-live.
Write statements of work that define scope and expectations, and expand engagements when new requirements surface.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder accounts, coordinating execution across internal departments and translating performance data into recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of listings, reputation, and marketing automation tools.
Shared structured, high-priority customer feedback with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
Built automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction, and retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Implemented and launched 25+ clients per month with ~25 concurrent onboardings at peak, holding 110% of implementation targets.
Scoped multi-session production plans for complex builds while aiming to launch simpler clients on the first call, keeping milestones on schedule.
Led and coached onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, piloting team structures for a new vertical that grew from proof of concept to profitable.
Defined the CRM fields required for onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients of a CRM, project, and billing platform, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team.
Advised C-suite clients on best practices and operational system design, aligning the platform to their growth stage and team structure.
Guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting setup and escalating risk early.
Ran workshops for client teams showing how each part of the product would work for them.
